entries.summary: On iPhone Duo and iPad, a Companion Page button in the chat's toolbar hides and shows the file beside the chat, and a chat setting turns off opening it automatically.
The companion page fades in beside the chat instead of appearing all at once, and appears without motion under Reduce Motion.
On iPhone Duo, the chat's toolbar buttons stay in the side bar while the companion page shows; the page's Follow and Files buttons join them.
